audit.schema:
CREATE TABLE audit(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,at REAL,actor TEXT,site TEXT,
 form TEXT,action TEXT,target TEXT)

block_status.schema: CREATE TABLE block_status(pin TEXT PRIMARY KEY,digest TEXT,state TEXT,version INTEGER)

capabilities.schema:
CREATE TABLE capabilities(prk TEXT PRIMARY KEY,version INTEGER,ledger TEXT,
 overrides TEXT,m3 INTEGER,fbks TEXT,ledger_seq INTEGER)

control_meta.schema: CREATE TABLE control_meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

deployments.schema: CREATE TABLE deployments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,version INTEGER,adapters TEXT)

drafts.schema:
CREATE TABLE drafts(site TEXT,form TEXT,version INTEGER,definition TEXT,author TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(site,form))

form_meta.schema: CREATE TABLE form_meta(site TEXT,form TEXT,title TEXT,cloned_from TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(site,form))

gate_intents.schema: CREATE TABLE gate_intents(prk TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

gates.schema: CREATE TABLE gates(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,blockers TEXT)

identity_types.schema: CREATE TABLE identity_types(site TEXT,form TEXT,identity TEXT,type TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(site,form,identity))

key_ledger.schema: CREATE TABLE key_ledger(site TEXT,form TEXT,path TEXT,identity TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(site,form,path))

local_active.schema: CREATE TABLE local_active (site_id TEXT NOT NULL, form_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_releases(candidate_id), version INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (site_id,form_id)) STRICT

local_publication_audit.schema: CREATE TABLE local_publication_audit (sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, action TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

local_releases.schema: CREATE TABLE local_releases (candidate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, site_id TEXT NOT NULL, form_id TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

managed_releases.schema:
CREATE TABLE managed_releases(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,site TEXT,form TEXT,review TEXT,
 fbks TEXT,at REAL)

memberships.schema: CREATE TABLE memberships(user TEXT,site TEXT,roles TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(user,site))

mock_effects.schema: CREATE TABLE mock_effects(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,submission TEXT UNIQUE,at REAL)

object_security.schema: CREATE TABLE object_security(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,version INTEGER,sources TEXT)

oidc_codes.schema:
CREATE TABLE oidc_codes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user TEXT,nonce TEXT,challenge TEXT,
 redirect TEXT,expires REAL)

oidc_states.schema: CREATE TABLE oidc_states(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,document TEXT,expires REAL)

oidc_tokens.schema: CREATE TABLE oidc_tokens(session TEXT PRIMARY KEY,envelope TEXT)

operations.schema:
CREATE TABLE operations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,review TEXT,site TEXT,form TEXT,
 state TEXT,version INTEGER,candidate TEXT,error TEXT,updated REAL,base INTEGER,platform TEXT)

outbox.schema: CREATE TABLE outbox(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,submission TEXT UNIQUE,state TEXT)

previews.schema:
CREATE TABLE previews(token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,session TEXT,site TEXT,form TEXT,
 version INTEGER,candidate TEXT,expires REAL)

review_contracts.schema: CREATE TABLE review_contracts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,document TEXT)

review_meta.schema: CREATE TABLE review_meta(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,platform TEXT,stale_reason TEXT)

reviews.schema:
CREATE TABLE reviews(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,site TEXT,form TEXT,version INTEGER,
 definition TEXT,digest TEXT,author TEXT,approver TEXT,state TEXT,base INTEGER)

schema_migrations.schema:
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
  version TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

sessions.schema:
CREATE TABLE sessions(token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user TEXT,csrf TEXT,
 created REAL,seen REAL)

submissions.schema:
CREATE TABLE submissions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,site TEXT,form TEXT,release TEXT,
 idem TEXT,hash TEXT,payload TEXT,receipt TEXT,UNIQUE(site,form,idem))

trusted_ledger.schema: CREATE TABLE trusted_ledger(prk TEXT PRIMARY KEY,seq INTEGER,state TEXT,commit_id TEXT)
